text:
An engineer wants to fix a steel washer on to a steel rod. The rod is just too big to fit into the hole
of the washer.
steel
steel rod
washer
How can the engineer fit the washer on to the rod?
A
Cool the washer and put it over the rod.
B
Cool the washer and rod to the same temperature and push them together.
C
Heat the rod and then place it in the hole.
D
Heat the washer and then place it over the rod.

options.label: A
options.text: Cool the washer and put it over the rod.

options.label: B
options.text: Cool the washer and rod to the same temperature and push them together.

options.label: C
options.text: Heat the rod and then place it in the hole.

options.label: D
options.text: Heat the washer and then place it over the rod.
